groups.name: documented-limitations
groups.description: Behavior listed in bugs.md. These pin today's output so a fix has to change a test on purpose; none of it is desired behavior

cases.desc: date with hyphens gets en dashes
phone number gets an en dash
letter and digit before the unit are read as a number and a temperature
no. followed by a number is read as a numero sign
capital letter before a capitalized word is read as an initial
initial rule also joins across a line break
backslash plus a shortcode name in a Windows path is expanded
a path whose name is not a shortcode is left alone
a path whose name is an emoticon shortcode is expanded
a LaTeX command with an argument keeps its braces
ja: hyphenated phone number gets en dashes
ko: hyphenated phone number gets en dashes
ja: doubled ellipsis character becomes two dot runs
ja: temperature gets a narrow no-break space, convention is none
ko: temperature gets a narrow no-break space, convention is none
apostrophe at the end of a piece is read as a closing quote while a single quote is pending
isolated quote in a piece of its own is read as an opener
a single quote before a number is opened when the number is in the next piece
number absorbed by the temperature rule is not multiplied
a % is not a left operand: percent before a minus in a math zone is not formatted
spaced % before a word is read as a percent sign even when it is modulo
math zone: a currency sign is not a right operand
math zone: an operator in a piece that starts with it has no left operand
math zone: a spaced hyphen between words is read as an operator, whatever the language
math zone: a unary minus before a word is not formatted, so it can still break after the hyphen
operator in its own inline piece is not seen
tight <- between a letter and a word is read as an arrow
spaced <- is read as an arrow even when it means less-than-minus
possessive plural inside a single quote closes it early (same glyphs, depth off)
inch mark inside an open double quote is read as a closer
lowercase quote starting with an elision word is read as an elision, and its closer then opens
capitalised elision is read as an opener
elision-like year inside a single quote leaves that quote unclosed
quote with whitespace on one side only at the end of the text opens
quote with whitespace on one side only at the start of the text opens
